about: Shared inputs and expected results for the Engineering settings record (zone engineering.settings, record id person). The engine crate orbyn-engineering runs this file in tests/settings_vectors.rs; the app can run it against its own port. Devices are A (stamp device 1) and B (stamp device 2). An op at `t` milliseconds is stamped (t, 0, device). Errors are snake_case names of SettingsError. Ops: set [key, value|null], add/remove [list, id], bind rule, unbind {key, when}, fill [list, n] (adds member-000 to member-(n-1)), `as` stamps with another device number (a copy that was synced earlier), `error` expects that error and no change. A value {repeat:{text,count}} is the text repeated and {repeat_list:{text,count}} a list of it. `inject` puts raw fields (name to {value, stamp}) into a device as a newer app would have written them. `merge: [X, Y]` is X accepting Y's fields and then Y accepting X's; the two must end equal, and `expect` is read from X (and `rejected` from X's acceptance). `fill [list, n, len]` pads each id with x to len characters. `fill [list, n, len, prefix]` pads ids made of the prefix and a 3-digit number; `churn [list, n]` adds and removes n distinct ids (each removal 1 ms after its add); `after` ops run on the first device after the merge and its checks. Expectations: has_field / no_field (a field name is present, even as a removal, or absent), record_bytes_over. `stored` loads a device's record as an earlier version stored it, before its ops; fields that never sync are dropped on load. `inject` is what a peer sends on the wire, which a `Settings` never holds.

the same id in the other set has its own list prefix
a chord with capitals and no when

scenarios.name: plain fields: different keys both survive, the same key goes to the later stamp
model_order is replaced whole by the last writer
null puts a plain field back to its default
add on A, remove on B after it: removed
remove on B before the add on A: the later add wins
a removal on A is not undone by B's older copy of the element
concurrent adds of different elements both stay, and sets are sorted
the same element added on both is one member
keybindings: with and without when are two rules
keybinding add on A, remove on B after it: removed
unbinding the rule with a when leaves the one without
rebinding the same key and when replaces the command by stamp
a remove rule is a rule like any other
a key from a newer app is kept and passed through an edit and a merge
an enum value a newer app added reads as the default and stays in the record
a theme id is accepted for default_theme
writes refuse bad values, unknown and unsynced keys and over-limit values
a value of exactly 8 KiB of JSON is accepted and one more byte is not
the sets and keybindings stop at 500 entries
incoming fields that may not be here are left out and named; the rest merges
a set field or rule that does not match its own name is not read
the whole record stops at 64 KiB, with the stamps counted
a peer cannot mark the record deleted: names starting with _ are refused in both directions
two devices that each filled the record converge, and a local write after it is refused
the record cap counts the real capacity: about 360 favourites of 60 characters, below the 500-entry list cap
churn of distinct ids leaves nulls; a young write is refused and an old-enough one compacts them
a removal older than 90 days is dropped by a local write and a younger one is kept
a removal exactly 90 days old is kept
ids are compared by raw bytes: NFC and NFD forms of the same name are two members
the four settings that widen what agents may do are dropped from remote input and named; the rest merges
an unknown key from a newer app is still kept and passed through (the app applies only its own allowlist)
the nine cost and reach settings are refused on write and dropped from remote input; the record is unchanged
a record stored by an earlier version holds never-synced fields: loading drops them, so nothing uploaded carries one, and a write after it does not either
loading such a record and not writing at all also leaves nothing that never syncs in the fields to upload
